posts.en:
dsh-complete-notify is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-74ad6c37af768dd82df5.html
